messages:
elaine: opening escalation — customer AcmeMaps reporting repeated 502/504s from hosted inference in eu-west starting ~02:12 UTC. Customer impact: API errors on /v1/generate, several timeouts. Any recent config changes or deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy INCDEP-432 finished to gateway-eu-west at 2026-03-15T01:58:02Z (image: gateway:v3.14.1)

sam: assigned, jumping in. Can someone paste a representative error?

elaine: here's one from the customer's trace: 
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:41Z] gateway ERROR upstream read timeout (504) route=/v1/generate customer=acmemaps req_id=abcd1234 backend=runtime-eu-west-1
[2026-03-15T02:12:41Z] auth-proxy WARN token refresh timeout to authz (timeout=3s) for user=svc-acmemaps
```

jules: seeing a brief spike in gateway 5xx at 02:11–02:20, p95 latency for gateway peaked to ~1.6s then a lot of 504s. No crashloop on pods. CPU steady.

maria: runtime traces show many requests stalled waiting for auth-proxy; authz latency spikes correlated. KV cache metrics look normal. Auth-proxy (authz) shows increased 5xx and connection queueing.

sam: ok hypothesis: auth-proxy upstream flapped after deploy to gateway caused a backlog -> gateway timed out waiting for runtime/auth -> 504s. Let's verify connections to auth-proxy and if circuit breaker/tripping occurred.

jules: checking: I see connection resets between gateway and auth-proxy around 02:10. No autoscale event triggered. Gateway circuit break count increased briefly.

maria: reproduction steps for support to confirm: 
1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Client-ID: acmemaps" https://api.eu-west.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
2) check response headers for x-redwood-upstream and x-redwood-req-id
If auth-proxy times out you should see: `upstream read timeout` and `x-authz-latency` header high.

elaine: customer ran a bulk synthetic job at 02:09 (they said) — could've amplified. They've attached sample request logs; I'll attach to the escalated ticket.

sam: immediate mitigations: 
• jules, temporarily route acmemaps traffic to eu-north fallback pool until we stabilize (can we add route override in routing rules?)
• maria, increase auth-proxy timeout from 3s -> 6s for a short window and monitor error rate
• jules, roll back the gateway config from 01:58 if we confirm correlation

jules: routing override ready, can send rule in infra console. Doing route swap for svc-acmemaps -> eu-north now.

support-bot: created escalation ticket REDW-7890 and attached customer logs.

maria: auth-proxy timeout bumped, monitoring dashboard: authz 5xx dropping after timeout change, gateway 504s falling.

sam: good. Keep routing override until postmortem. Action items for the follow-up postmortem: 
1) root cause owner: maria (auth-proxy).
2) rollback audit: jules to confirm if any gateway deploy with config that touches connection pooling happened at 01:58.
3) rate limit policy: product/support to discuss soft-throttles for bulk customers during off-hours (elaine).
4) add synthetic canary for auth-proxy every 30s from multiple regions (eng-sre).
5) update runbook to include routing override steps and a short checklist for auth-proxy timeout bump (sam).

elaine: customer notified and accepted workaround. They've asked for postmortem and ETA on permanent fix.

sam: I'll create a follow-up doc and schedule a postmortem meeting. Target: action items owned and draft postmortem within 48h.

jules: noted — rolling back gateway config now as precaution, will confirm in 5m.

maria: after rollback confirm auth-proxy error rate. If it resurfaces, we escalate infra/network.

sam: thanks all. If anything changes ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
